experiment: Frozen-routing 2x2 factorial ablation of MoE GPTQ calibration (FR s0 / FC s0, four layers)
question: Does freezing the expert assignments used to build calibration Hessians suppress the GPTQ weight and PPL sensitivity caused by changing the BF16 calibration batch composition?

grouping.name: G20261111
grouping.reason: first seed of the prespecified multigroup list; fixed before any factorial result

alignment: (original sequence id, token position): ORIGINAL cache row = sid; G20261111 cache row i = union_calibration_ids[i]; every sequence is 512 tokens in both caches
routing_capture: ordered top-k of the model's own GPU softmax(float)+topk inside the batch-1 layer replay of each cache (the E3 Profiler path); validated against the unmodified Profiler's per-sequence routed-token counts
hessian_semantics: unmodified E3 Profiler + BlockHessianAccumulator: per expert UNWEIGHTED sums over routed tokens of x x^T (gate/up input = MoE-block input) and z z^T (z = act(gate x)*up x computed by the expert with its ORIGINAL BF16 weights), K blocks by chosen order, summed; router weights scale only the expert OUTPUT and are not part of the Hessian
intervention: selected_experts replaced inside a verbatim copy of Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock.forward, ONLY during the Hessian-building Profiler run; reconstruction Profiler, inference and PPL use the class forward; the block output under forced routing is discarded (non-sequential calibration)
reconstruction: E3 held-out relative reconstruction on ~/moe_cache test rows 2128-2255 (eval_cache_dir), natural routing
regression_requirements: identical routed-token counts (manifest vs unmodified Profiler)
bitwise-identical gate/up and down Hessians (forced path vs unmodified Profiler, all 480) and identical act-order permutations
reconstruction (mean and per expert) == frozen reference
PPL: implied by bitwise weights + the verified deterministic evaluator (not re-run)

diagnostic_subset.note: prespecified (= the partial-PPL expert-check subset); act-order and diag statistics are recorded for ALL 240 experts

metrics_per_strategy.h_C: median over the 16 prespecified diagnostic Hessians (layers 1/8/16/23 x experts 0/30 x gu/down) of the trace-normalized relative Frobenius difference ||H_C/tr H_C - H_OO/tr H_OO||_F / ||H_OO/tr H_OO||_F
metrics_per_strategy.w_C: relative L2 difference of all 720 effective weight tensors of condition C from OO
metrics_per_strategy.dY_C: PPL(C) - PPL(OO); contrasts A_R0 = Y_AO - Y_OO, R_X0 = Y_OA - Y_OO, I = Y_AA - Y_AO - Y_OA + Y_OO
metrics_per_strategy.TAU: 0.000924 = 1e-4 x BF16 PPL (deterministic tolerance of the grouping studies); |x| < TAU is treated as 0

flags_per_strategy.activation_dominant: h_AO > h_OA AND w_AO > w_OA AND |dY_AO| > |dY_OA| (with |dY_AO| > TAU)

precedence: RUN-BLOCKED: a natural-condition regression (routing, Hessians, weights, reconstruction) fails, a hybrid configuration is missing / invalid, or forced routing was active during evaluation
FROZEN-ROUTING-SUPPRESSES-SENSITIVITY: local_suppression AND ppl_suppression in BOTH strategies AND ranking_preserved AND NOT interaction_large in either strategy
LOCAL-ROUTING-EFFECT-WITHOUT-PPL-EXPLANATION: (local_suppression OR local_routing_dominant) in BOTH strategies, AND (ppl_suppression fails in at least one strategy OR NOT ranking_preserved)
ROUTING-AND-ACTIVATION-INTERACT: otherwise (neither factor alone explains the natural effect, or the interaction is large); the interaction flags are always reported
decision_rule.frozen: fixed before any hybrid (AO / OA) quantization or PPL; never adjusted after outcomes

hard_constraints: no re-selection, seed 0, grouping G20261111 only, 4 layers, frozen GPTQ / windows / evaluation, no forced routing at inference, no additional groupings or seeds after results

environment.note: determinism settings are recorded, not changed (changing them would change ORIGINAL numerics)
